title: ProductRequest - Data API
description: Represents an order for a part or parts in field service.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The account associated with the product request. This is a relationship field.

CaseId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CaseId.description: The case associated with the product request. This is a relationship field.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only if the multicurrency feature is enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization. The label in the user interface is Currency ISO Code.

Description.description: A text field for details not recorded in the provided fields.

DestinationLocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DestinationLocationId.description: Where the product is delivered. This is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the product request was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the product request was last viewed.

NeedByDate.description: Date the product must be delivered by.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the shipment. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProductRequestNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
ProductRequestNumber.description: An auto-assigned number that identifies the shipment.

ShipToAddress.description: The address that the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToCity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToCity.description: The city that the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToCountry.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToCountry.description: The country that the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToCountryCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToCountryCode.description: A two letter uppercase country code conforming to the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard.

ShipToGeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ShipToGeocodeAccuracy.description: The accuracy of the geocode for the shipping address.

ShipToLatitude.description: The latitude of the location where the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToLongitude.description: The longitude of the location where the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToPostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToPostalCode.description: The postal code of the address where the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToState.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToState.description: The name of the state where the product is to be delivered to.

ShipToStateCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToStateCode.description: A two letter uppercase state code conforming to the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard.

ShipToStreet.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipToStreet.description: The street address where the product is to be delivered to.

ShipmentType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ShipmentType.description: The type of shipment. The picklist includes the following values by default: None Rush Overnight Next Business Day Pick Up

SourceLocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceLocationId.description: The location the product is shipped from. This is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

WorkOrderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkOrderId.description: The work order that the product request is related to. This is a relationship field.

WorkOrderLineItemId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkOrderLineItemId.description: The work order line item that the product request is related to. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules:
Field Service must be enabled. Authenticated external users can create and update ProductRequest objects.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ProductRequestChangeEvent (API version 48.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ProductRequestFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ProductRequestHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ProductRequestOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ProductRequestShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
